minutes.headline: ZBA heard a self-storage special permit for 270 Electric Ave and continued the hearing to May 27 over a mailing error.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard an application for a special permit to build a self-storage facility at 270 Electric Avenue, replacing an outdoor storage use. The applicant described the site plan, traffic, drainage, snow removal, fire protection, lighting and hours, and members asked questions. No vote on the permit was taken because of a glitch in mailing to abutters; the hearing was continued to May 27.
